title: Zesty Ukrainian White Asparagus Wrap
description: A citrusy, flaky wrap featuring tender white asparagus, fresh herbs, and crunchy veggies, perfect for a sick day or quick lunch.
instructions: Blanch the white asparagus spears for 2 minutes in boiling salted water, then shock them in ice water to retain color.
Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a pan and sauté minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the asparagus spears to the pan and stir for 2 minutes, then remove from heat.
In a bowl combine lemon juice, chopped dill, and a pinch of salt to create a zesty dressing.
Dip each softened rice paper sheet in warm water for 5 seconds, then lay flat on a clean surface.
Spread a thin layer of the dressing over the rice paper.
Arrange asparagus, cucumber, carrot, chickpeas, and seaweed strips in the center of each sheet.
Fold the sides over the filling and roll tightly to form a wrap.
Repeat for all sheets and serve immediately, optionally with extra lemon wedges.
